description: Source code implementing a class for managing a whitelist of origin domains, including parsing JSON data, requesting whitelist data from WPEFramework, and adding whitelist entries to WebKit.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: Represents a JSON object for origin, domain, and subdomain information used in parsing whitelist JSON data.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses a JSON string containing whitelist entries and populates the internal whitelist map.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::RequestFromWPEFramework
methods.description: Requests whitelist data from WPEFramework via a synchronous message and returns a populated whitelist object.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to WebKit as origin access whitelist entries.
